content: Stdio child-process testing patterns in Go: (1) in-process fake over io.Pipe/net.Pipe - the fake backend implements the protocol handlers and both sides run in one test binary; deterministic and race-detector friendly (coder SDK Connection works on io.Reader/Writer so pipes plug in directly). (2) TestHelperProcess reexec pattern (os.Getenv GO_WANT_HELPER_PROCESS + exec.Command(os.Args[0]) with -test.run=TestHelperProcess): convention from Go stdlib exec tests, not in pkg.go.dev docs. (3) prebuilt fake backend binary built in TestMain via go build to t.TempDir - replays recorded JSONL transcripts. (4) golden files: sebdah/goldie/v2 (fixtures in testdata/, -update flag, AssertJson) or hand-rolled -update helper; acp-tck (agentclientprotocol org, Python, uvx, spawns agent over stdio, MANDATORY/CAPABILITY/ADVISORY tiers, CONFORMANT verdict, exit codes) usable as an external conformance gate in CI, marked experimental.
